  Plan B++ (α) — Semantic Priority Rule P via Absorber Count

  STEP 1249 footer §278-290 outlined Plan B++ as needing "a canonical
  semantic priority rule that selects SELF (or another extension axis)
  as the 'Liar-specific' evaluation for self-referential sentences",
  and noted "this rule cannot come from Dfumt8's algebra alone — it
  must be introduced as a semantic principle".

  Rei-project 2026-07-28 close-of-session listed three Rule P candidates:
    (α) absorber-count / (β) Priest-type / (γ) Kripke minimal-fp.
  The founder chose (α)
